'''Clucky''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Cluckeroo]] at 4 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "'Clucky's leaves can photosynthesize, but that is not an excuse to skip feeding time.' -Tatari Observation Diary."

Clucky is your starting Tatari when you first begin playing the game, given to you at the start of the tutorial, along with [[Zapup]].

==Appearance==
Clucky is a small, round, chick-like Tatari. It has a round, red beak and two small, thin, red colored legs. Its eyes are large and brown. Its wings are green, almost resembling leaves. It has a small, green, bowtie-like marking on its chest and a plant sprout on top of its head.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Clucky's leaves provide photosynthesis, but it still needs to be fed.' -Clucky Handbook"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "The sprout on Clucky's head is for photosynthetic purposes. Often stays hidden in tall grass to quietly observe nearby surroundings."

== Strategy ==
[[File:Clucky Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Clucky's attack range]]
Simple early game grass DPS. Is best placed where it can counter Rock types.
